title: Give the aldehyde hydrogen
hook: Predict the product, then compare the bonds.

knows: Structural formula bonds and common organic functional groups.
doesNotKnow: Sodium borohydride reduces an aldehyde to a primary alcohol after workup. The carbonyl carbon of ethanal becomes the CH₂ bearing OH in ethanol.

misconception: Reaction conditions do not affect the connectivity of the product.
objective: Predict the organic product of ethanal under the stated conditions and identify the changed connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structural diagrams, product and explanation: Ethanal is treated with NaBH₄, then water. Which major organic product forms after workup? Sodium borohydride reduces an aldehyde to a primary alcohol after workup. The carbonyl carbon of ethanal becomes the CH₂ bearing OH in ethanol.
The diagrams use condensed labels and depict connectivity rather than molecular geometry; highlighting identifies selected changed groups.
